sources.title: Visual Question Answering - GitHub
sources.snippet: A Light weight deep learning model with with a web application to answer image-based questions with a non-generative approach for the VizWiz grand challenge 2023 by carefully curating the answer vocabulary and adding linear layer on top of Open AI's CLIP model as image and text encoder - yousefkotp/Visual-Question-Answering

sources.title: VQA: Visual Question Answering
sources.snippet: VQA is a new dataset containing open-ended questions about images. These questions require an understanding of vision, language and commonsense knowledge to answer.

sources.title: (PDF) VISUAL QUESTION ANSWERING - ResearchGate
sources.snippet: This paper presents a new baseline for visual question answering task. Given an image and a question in natural language, our model produces accurate answers according to the content of the image.
